footnote_text: Prorated annual grant of time-based restricted stock units ("RSUs") granted pursuant to the Company's Amended and Restated 2018 Global Incentive Plan.  The RSUs vest in full on May 11, 2027.  Each RSU represents the right to receive one share of Common Stock.  The reporting person may elect to have receipt of the shares of Common Stock deferred under the Company's 2008 Deferred Compensation Plan.
